title: Callaloo and Saltfish
subtitle: Salt cod with leafy callaloo, scotch bonnet and tomato
excerpt: Flaked salt cod cooked with callaloo leaves, tomato and scotch bonnet. A classic Jamaican breakfast served with fried dumplings or boiled green banana.
sourceNotes: Traditional Jamaican breakfast dish; callaloo refers to the leaf of the taro plant in Jamaica.

recipe.makeAheadNotes: The saltfish can be soaked and boiled the evening before. Store flaked in the fridge overnight.

content.text: Callaloo and saltfish is a Jamaican morning dish of flaked salt cod cooked with dark leafy callaloo, tomato and scotch bonnet. It gives a savoury, satisfying plateful. The key step is soaking the saltfish well the night before to remove most of the salt.

items.prepNote: soaked in cold water for at least 8 hours, water changed twice

content.text: Drain the soaked saltfish. Place in the saucepan and cover with fresh cold water. Bring to the boil and simmer for 15 minutes.
Drain and leave to cool slightly. Remove any skin and bones. Use your fingers to flake the fish into small pieces.
Heat the oil in the frying pan over a medium heat. Add the onion and spring onion. Cook for 3 minutes until softened.
Add the garlic, scotch bonnet and thyme. Stir for 1 minute until fragrant.
Add the tomato and cook for 2 minutes until it softens and releases its juice.
Add the callaloo and flaked saltfish. Stir well. Cover and cook for 5 minutes until the callaloo wilts right down.
Uncover and stir. Season with black pepper only. The saltfish provides enough salt. Serve hot.

items.cause: The saltfish was not soaked long enough.
items.fix: Soak for a full 8 hours, changing the water twice. Boiling in fresh water also removes more salt.

items.symptom: The callaloo is tough and stringy.
items.cause: The thick central stalks were left in.
items.fix: Strip the leaves away from the stalks before chopping. Only the leaves go into the pan.

items.symptom: The fish is still very salty after soaking.
items.cause: The fish was a very thick or heavily cured piece.
items.fix: Boil in two changes of fresh water, draining and refilling each time, before flaking.
